facts.statement: Amazon search results for the small-animal bedding sifter/scoop category surface multiple named competitor products, most configured as plastic or metal 2-3 piece sifter/scoop sets: Cold Life Super Scoop Sifter, Niteangel Hamster Sand Bath Scoop, Ilofdsn 3-pc Hamster Metal Litter Scoop, tafit Hamster Litter Scoop Sifter, BFLCTTBD 2-pc set, and Mollcouver 2-pc set.

The tafit Hamster Litter Scoop Sifter (ASIN B0B5VFJ8BN) is marketed with roughly 0.2cm (~2mm) sieve holes to sift hamster/guinea pig/chinchilla droppings from sand or bedding; its exact current price and star rating could not be retrieved this session because Amazon product pages are blocked by network egress.
Walmart's 'Hamster Sand Scoop Mini' for guinea pig/hamster cages is priced at $5.56 (list price $8.02) with no ratings yet.
Walmart's 'Kimmy&Co Pet Waste Management Scoops' line for small pets starts at $10.17.
A 'Scoop Shovel Beach Mesh Shovel' small-pet sifting scoop lists at $4.29 on Walmart.
A Walmart-listed 12-piece hamster/guinea-pig pet bath spoon litter scoop multi-pack carries roughly 3.6 out of 5 stars from about 73 reviews.

A customer review of the Walbest Cat Litter Scoop (also marketed for hamsters and other small animals) specifically reports the sifting holes were too small and did not let clean litter/bedding pass through, causing over-scooping of clean material.

Search-engine aggregation confirms the core buyer complaint: a standard cat-litter scoop's holes are sized for clumping clay litter and are too large for loose small-animal bedding and droppings, letting waste and fines fall through together or pass nothing at all.
A cat-litter-scoop review roundup reports common negative patterns of litter/clumps scattering or sticking to the scoop's plastic mesh, and scoops being too large or heavy for smaller hands/wrists.
An Etsy hamster sand-sifter listing carries a five-star review praising it as well-made and effective at keeping sand/bedding clean.

2026 Amazon FBA small-standard fulfillment fees run about $2.46 for sub-$10 priced items and about $3.32 for items priced $10-$50 in the lighter (~2oz) weight band, after a roughly $0.12/unit increase effective 2026-01-15, plus a new 3.5% fuel-and-logistics surcharge on base fulfillment fees effective 2026-04-17.
Amazon's Pet Supplies referral fee is 15% of the total sales price (minimum $0.30/item) for most pet products; veterinary-diet pet items are charged 22%.
2026 Amazon FBA monthly storage fee for standard-size inventory is about $0.78 per cubic foot from January through September and about $2.40 per cubic foot during Q4 peak season (October-December).

Plastic pet accessories such as litter/sand scoops commonly classify under HTS 3926.90.99.89 ('other articles of plastics, not elsewhere specified'), which carries a general/MFN duty rate of about 5.3%; a tariff-calculator example for this HTS line sourced from China cites a stacked effective rate of about 25.3% once additional China-specific tariffs are layered on.

Section 301 China tariffs in effect for 2026 add either 25% (List 3) or 7.5% (List 4A) on top of the base MFN duty depending on the exact HTS subheading; general plastic housewares/pet-accessory lines are commonly cited under List 4A (7.5%), though this session could not confirm the exact subheading assignment against the official USTR list.

2026 China-to-US LCL ocean freight base rates run roughly $80-$180 per cubic metre (CBM), with realistic all-in landed LCL cost (adding CFS handling both ends, THC, BAF, and documentation fees) running about 40-70% above that base quote.

price_ladder.anchor_note: Generic single/multi-pack scoops (non-calibrated-mesh) triangulate low, $4.29-$10.17 across two Walmart listings (F3, F4, F5). True sifter-tray-plus-scoop combo sets (closer analogs to the brief's product, e.g. tafit/Ilofdsn/Niteangel/BFLCTTBD, F1-F2) could not have prices independently confirmed this session because Amazon product pages are egress-blocked; the $21.59 max and the $17.99 implied median come from the brief's own stated target price band, not an independently observed page-1 read this session — flagged as a gap, not verified.

variant_chosen.description: Plastic 2-to-3-piece sifter/scoop combo set (a fine-mesh sifter tray or scoop paired with a separate waste scoop), rather than a single stand-alone scoop or an all-metal sand-bath-only scoop.
variant_chosen.why: Five of the seven organic Amazon results surfaced for the category (tafit, Ilofdsn 3pc, BFLCTTBD 2pc, Mollcouver 2pc, Cold Life) are multi-piece plastic combo sets, matching the brief's own in-the-box spec (mesh tray + scoop). Could not confirm with hard review-count/rank data this session (F1) - treat as directional, not settled.

complaint_clusters.pattern: The scoop's mesh/holes are sized for clumping cat litter, so on small-animal bedding it either lets fines fall through with the waste or catches nothing at all, forcing the owner to over-discard clean bedding or leave waste in the cage.
complaint_clusters.root_cause_hypothesis: Mesh gauge tuned for clay-litter clumps, not loose paper/aspen bedding fines, so a repurposed cat-litter or generic scoop mis-separates small-animal bedding on first real use.
paraphrased_examples: Holes too small, clean bedding would not sift through
Scoop lets everything fall through with the waste

complaint_clusters.pattern: The plastic scoop or sifter body feels flimsy, clumps stick to the mesh instead of separating cleanly, and the handle is uncomfortable or oversized for a small cage opening.
complaint_clusters.root_cause_hypothesis: Thin molded plastic and a handle/head sized for cat litter boxes rather than smaller cage openings causes clump adhesion and hand discomfort over repeated use.
paraphrased_examples: Clumps stick to the plastic mesh instead of falling through
Scoop felt bulky for a small cage opening

praise_clusters.pattern: A properly fine, purpose-built mesh sifts sand/bedding fines while trapping waste and clumps, keeping the habitat visibly cleaner and stretching bedding life between full changes.

referral_rate.assumption: Pet Supplies referral fee is a flat 15% of total sale price (min $0.30/item) per current aggregator summaries (F12); high end allows for possible misclassification into a pricier pet sub-category or a per-tier bump not confirmed this session.

fba_fee_usd.assumption: 2026 small-standard fulfillment fees run ~$2.46 (sub-$10 price band, lighter ~2oz weight row) to ~$3.32 ($10-$50 band) per third-party fee trackers (F11); base uses the brief's own prior estimate ($3.38) as a midpoint since the exact 8oz weight-tier row was not retrievable from the official Seller Central rate card (blocked this session); high end adds room for the 3.5% fuel/logistics surcharge effective 2026-04-17. Confidence medium, not the official rate card.

storage_per_cuft_month_usd.assumption: 2026 standard-size monthly storage is $0.78/cu ft Jan-Sep and $2.40/cu ft during Q4 peak (F13); base is a rough annual blend (9 months low + 3 months high).

duty_rate.assumption: HTS 3926.90.99.89 ('other articles of plastics') carries a general/MFN duty of ~5.3% (F14); range allows for classification under an adjacent plastics/housewares subheading with a somewhat different published MFN rate - exact classification not confirmed with a customs broker this session.

sea_freight_usd_per_cbm.assumption: 2026 China-to-US LCL base ocean freight runs $80-$180/CBM; realistic all-in landed LCL cost (adding CFS both ends, THC, BAF, documentation) runs ~40-70% above the base quote, pushing the effective high end toward ~$270/CBM (F16).

additional_tariff_rate.assumption: Section 301 China tariffs add 7.5% (List 4A, the commonly-cited bucket for general plastic pet accessories) up to 25% (List 3) depending on the exact 8-digit HTS subheading (F15); this range does NOT include any separate 2025/2026 IEEPA 'reciprocal' tariff layer, which this session could not source a current rate for - see gaps.

trends: Amazon raised small-standard FBA fulfillment fees roughly $0.12/unit effective 2026-01-15 and added a 3.5% fuel-and-logistics surcharge on base fulfillment fees effective 2026-04-17, both increasing landed cost pressure on small, light pet accessories like this one (F11).

China-sourced plastic goods continue to carry stacked Section 301 tariffs (7.5%-25% depending on HTS list) on top of base MFN duty through 2026, keeping landed cost elevated for China-origin plastic pet-care accessories (F14, F15).
